item.title: Take a look inside the Air Force One plane that carried 8 presidents and brought home JFK's body from Dallas
item.description: The first Air Force jet designed specifically for US presidents, SAM 26000 carried every president from John F. Kennedy to Bill Clinton.

item.title: OpenClaw's creator is heading to OpenAI. He says it could've been a 'huge company,' but building one didn't excite him.
item.description: Sam Altman said OpenClaw creator Peter Steinberger is joining OpenAI to drive development of personal AI agents.

item.title: They moved to China for a new adventure. Their 3 kids gained independence — and mom has time for hobbies.
item.description: Elisa Orsi and David Sleight moved to China with their kids and were surprised to see how clean, modern, and convenient everything was.

item.title: I took a risk moving to Phuket as a single mom. It paid off.
item.description: Browsing jobs in Phuket became Cheska Hull's guilty pleasure. When she called off her wedding, she decided it was time to move to Thailand.

item.title: Elon Musk says Anthropic's philosopher has no stake in the future because she doesn't have kids. Here's her response.
item.description: Elon Musk questioned Amanda Askell's role in shaping AI Claude's morals, citing her lack of children. Askell had thoughts.

item.title: The Trial of Seven in 'A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms' nearly kills Dunk. Here's how he actually dies in the books.
item.description: "A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms" episode 5 features a deadly Trial of Seven, but Dunk survives the fight. Here's how Dunk dies in the books.

item.title: A blink-and-you-miss-it scene in 'A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms' ties Dunk to his most famous descendant, Brienne of Tarth
item.description: The "A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms" showrunner said he included a brief scene in episode 5 to hint at Dunk's relation to Brienne in "Game of Thrones."

item.title: Jacob Elordi, 28, says he has 'no relationship' with social media
item.description: "I have so much love in my life, and the relationships I have in my life are so present and real," Jacob Elordi said.

item.title: The founder of a huge boba chain said he opened stores next to Starbucks to get a fraction of its customers
item.description: Gong Cha founder Martin Berry said that if he could get one in 100 people to buy Gong Cha instead of Starbucks, he would have a business.

item.title: Snowflake's CEO says software giants risk becoming a 'dumb data pipe' to AI models
item.description: "The big model makers want to create a world in which all of the data for all of the enterprises is easily available to them," Sridhar Ramaswamy said.
